title: Hearty Argentinian Fish Empanadas
description: A traditional Argentinian dish featuring whole wheat empanadas filled with poached fish, perfect for a kid-friendly meal. This pescatarian-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Make empanada dough by combining whole wheat flour, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Gradually add water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Poach fish fillets in water until cooked through.
Chop cooked fish into small pieces and mix with chopped onion and minced garlic.
Place a spoonful of the fish mixture onto the center of each empanada disk.
Fold the empanada disk in half and press edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with egg wash.
Bake empanadas in the preheated oven for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
